text_02: Values-based coaching for growth and transition.
text_03: For individuals who live outside of California, I offer life coaching services that draw on many of the same tools I use in therapy—mindfulness, values clarification, accountability, and gentle but steady support—within a coaching framework.
text_04: Coaching is future-focused and goal-oriented. Together, we might clarify your values, identify patterns that keep you stuck, and design practical experiments to move toward more meaningful work, relationships, creativity, or self-care. Coaching can be especially helpful during life transitions, career changes, or seasons where you feel called to grow but aren’t sure how to begin.
text_06: Coaching is not psychotherapy and does not include diagnosis or treatment of mental health conditions.
text_07: Therapy services are provided only to clients who are physically located in California at the time of session.
text_08: Coaching can be available to clients in other states or countries, depending on scheduling and fit.
text_09: If you’re unsure whether therapy or coaching is a better fit, we can discuss this together during an initial consultation.
